description: This PHP script handles searching and displaying requirement data within the TestLink project, including building SQL queries based on user input, fetching matching requirements, and rendering the results as an HTML table.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: Custom class for rendering external tables with features like sorting, grouping, and toolbar functionalities.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Custom subclass or wrapper around Smarty templating engine used for rendering HTML templates.

methods.name: buildExtTable
methods.description: Constructs an HTML table object based on the search results and configuration for display.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes search arguments from user input, converting dates and handling defaults.

methods.name: build_search_sql
methods.description: Constructs a complex SQL query based on user search parameters to retrieve matching requirements and related data.
